title: Plaid button
description: A pill button in five finishes: near-black or white inside a thin rainbow rim (lime, teal, cyan, periwinkle, pink, yellow), a pale mint wash, a teal-to-blue or cyan-to-periwinkle fill, or a periwinkle outline. Rimmed pills pick up a soft periwinkle glow on hover; the washes shift colour.
notes: the rainbow rim is drawn from chart-4/5, highlight, glow, chart-3 and chart-2
name: plaid-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description:
ink: near-black inside a rainbow rim · paper: white inside a rainbow rim ·
mint: pale mint wash (on the blue bands) · aqua: teal into bright cyan fill · sky: cyan-to-periwinkle fill ·
outline: periwinkle hairline

props.name: size
props.description: md: 38px tall, 16px text (header) · lg: 48px on phones and 56px on desktop, 20px text

props.name: type
props.description: the button's type when it isn't a link (e.g. "submit" inside a form)
